snippets.snippet_text: "At the end of August, I had to cancel 7 orders to the USA because I wasn't yet set up with a proper solution for handling the new US tariff/duty requirements. It was a really difficult decision, but I didn't want to risk non-compliance or surprise charges for my customers. Thankfully, 4 of those customers asked me to reserve their items and were very understanding."

"I got set up with Zonos (for direct billing of duties and taxes) and verified and integrated with Canada Post for shipping on their platform. I created dozens of duplicate shipping profiles within Etsy to reflect estimated tariff costs based on various items with different Country of Origin (COO)"
